# Travel Eye Sri Lanka

> A Sri Lanka travel discovery website with destinations, experiences, suggested tours and a travel journal. Visitors can plan a journey or contact a travel designer.

Tours and planner journeys are suggestions. Confirm availability, transfers and final arrangements with the travel team.

## Explore

- [Explore the island](/explore): Interactive map and hidden places.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Published Sri Lankan destinations.
- [Experiences](/experiences): Activities and local experiences.
- [Tours](/tours): Suggested itineraries and published tour details.
- [Journal](/journal): Travel articles and inspiration.

## Planning and contact

- [Plan a journey](/plan): Build a sample journey around travel preferences.
- [About and contact](/about#contact): Contact the travel team.
- [Photography credits](/photo-credits): Photograph sources and licenses.

This file is informational; it does not override robots.txt or grant access to private admin or API resources.
